scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @mora/songtitle build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && corepack pnpm --dir Admin build
scripts.check: corepack pnpm --filter @mora/songtitle build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && corepack pnpm --dir Admin check
scripts.infra:status: wrangler whoami && wrangler d1 list --config Server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler r2 bucket list --config Server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler queues list --config Server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply mora-public --local --config Server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply mora-admin --local --config Server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply mora-public --remote --config Server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler d1 migrations apply mora-admin --remote --config Server/wrangler.jsonc
